title: Check out my project
author: astronautm77
selftext: Any criticism is welcomed. Im building an jrpg with claude. This is an open world cartoon style. Every building you see is navigable. This game is ai made but human refined. Im still a long way from having a finished product.

comments.author: IchiPasento
comments.body:
Love the feel of the city, very JSR 

What’s the scope of the game?

replies.author: astronautm77
replies.body: Fantasy science fi rpg. A mix of trails and final fantasy and GTA. This is a game I wished the industry would have made. Im going to add side missions. Fictional technology. Hidden ruins. A an epic story involving aliens spirits and gods

replies.author: IchiPasento
replies.body:
Phenomenal. 

I’d prevent showing anymore until you are ready to drop a demo. 

Stay in line with your vision and pump out the work.

replies.author: astronautm77
replies.body: Yeah good advice I just wanted to show people that if you put in the time you can make a good game. These anti ai people and coding is an an artform people are trying to label anything ai as bad. If someone takes my idea and makes a great game I'll be happy and ill play it.

replies.author: IchiPasento
replies.body:
Yeah understood.  I still think keep your process quiet until it is at a demo stage. Only because the Anti-Ai crowd could really fuck up your games reputation if they get enough time with it , and this could affect the games reception when you release it. 

and true, others might steal it and you don’t mind, but remember you can make money from your game which will help your life.  I used to give music away for free and now as a grown man, I regret it.  Try not to be so quick to give away your goods!

replies.author: astronautm77
replies.body: I here you. What i meant was that im mixing other ideas together. What's mine is my spin and my story. That cant be cloned. I have a great story to tell but im first trying to create the world that it's going to take place in. I appreciate the advice. And im open to ideas to improve my game. At the end of the day if the game is good people will buy it. Thats my hope

comments.author: I_Rarely_Jump
comments.body: Ask claude how to record a video on your pc...

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body: Seems like the human didn’t refine that much

comments.author: ail-san
comments.body: So pumped. Be careful before posting, they will clone this one the same day

replies.author: astronautm77
replies.body: I hope they do so I can play a decent rpg.

comments.author: IchiPasento
comments.body: Good luck! You’ve got passion and an idea, like you said - People will buy it if it’s good.
